description: Figure 6 illustrates the proportion of harmful responses exhibiting a rejection tendency across different query lengths. The x-axis is labeled “Query Length” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 16, with tick labels at integer values. The y-axis is labeled “Proportion” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. There is one line in the plot, colored blue and solid. At a query length of 0, the proportion is approximately 0.45. The line generally declines as query length increases, reaching a proportion of approximately 0.15 at a query length of 16. There are no apparent peaks or reversals in the trend.
